goal.text: Add caching to the report endpoint so repeated requests finish under 200 ms.

stableFacts.text: The report endpoint previously called buildReport for every request and had no cache.

constraints.text: Do not change the public JSON response shape.

decisions.text: Use a five-minute in-memory TTL cache keyed by account id.

importantToolFindings.text: Inspection of src/report.ts found that buildReport ran directly on every request.

completedWork.text: Changed the key to account id, added cache hit and expiry tests, and passed the targeted tests.

unresolvedWork.text: The full test suite and p95 latency measurement have not yet been run.

failedApproaches.text: Keying by display name failed because different accounts can share a name.

nextActions.text: Run the full test suite and measure p95 latency.
